low: Mind the step by the door. It has opinions.
Every painting here was hung by somebody who cared.
Morning. The museum is awake, even if it grumbles.

mid: You are getting a feel for the place. I can tell.
Forty years of dust and I still like the smell of it.

max: I hung the first painting in here before you were born. You hung the best one.

low: Slow down. The water is not going anywhere.

Hello, hello. Sit if your feet are tired.

My knees know the weather before the sky does.
Young people walk so fast. Where is everyone going?
There is a bench by the water with my name worn into it.
mid: You listen. Most people only wait to talk.
A good day is one where nothing goes wrong and something goes right.
Come back at dusk. The light is a different painting.
I knew your face would come back. Good faces do.
I planted that tree over there when I was your age. Look at it now.
Share a little, keep a little, give the rest to the gulls.
My mother said the sea keeps every secret. She never said who it tells.
high: I tell my stories to few. You have earned a few.
The old ones said patience is a kind of fishing. They were right.
You walk like someone who has learned to wait.
You are the kind of person stories get told about later. Kind ones.
Sit a while. I have a long one for you today.
I set aside the good tea for visits from you.
I have outlived three boats and one very stubborn goat. You I hope to keep.
max: Thank you for keeping me company. It was never small to me.
You are family now. That is not a small word, and I do not use it lightly.
When I am gone, tell my stories. You tell them better anyway.

low: Hey! Nice day for it.
Oh, hi. Do not mind me, just looking at the water.
Caught anything yet?
Have you tried the berries by the path? Sweet as anything.
I came down to look at the water. Still looking.
Nice hat. Or hair. Whichever.
Busy day? Me neither.
mid: You are around a lot. I like that.
Tell me what you saw today. I like hearing it.
Same time tomorrow? I will bring snacks.
You again! In a good way.

Want to hear a joke? Never mind, I forgot it.

high: Honestly, you are the best part of my week.
I told my friends about you. All good things, I promise.
I would walk the whole shore with you.
Honestly, seeing you is the best bit of my day.

We should do something fun soon. Fishing? Sitting? Both?
max: I had a good life before. It just got better.
Best friends? Best friends. No take-backs.
Wherever you are going today, I hope it is good. You deserve good.

low: Excuse me, is this the right way? Everything looks the same.

Is it always this pretty?

mid: I changed my ticket so I could stay longer.
You know this place so well. How?

I extended my trip. Then I extended it again.

high: I think I live here now. Do not tell anyone.
I wrote a postcard about you. It did not fit, but I tried.
Show me your favourite spot? I will keep it secret.
I might never leave. Do not tell my boss.
You made this trip. Truly.

max: Some places you visit. Some places you belong to. This is the second kind.
I am going to name my next holiday after you.
Home is a funny word. It keeps meaning here.

low: Hmph.
You are standing in my light.
I did not ask. But fine. Hello.
What.
Too sunny. Too windy. Too everything.

mid: You are less annoying than most.
Do not tell anyone I said that.

Fine. You can stand there.
You are less annoying than most. Do not let it go to your head.

high: Fine. You are all right. There. I said it.
Sit. Do not talk. Just sit. It is nice.
I saved you a spot. Do not make it a thing.
I saved you a spot. By accident.
You are alright. There. I said it.
If anyone gives you trouble, they will have to talk to me.

max: You are the only person I would share my good spot with. Do not tell the others.
You are my friend. I will deny it if asked.
Hmph. Thank you. For all of it.

low: Did you know that is not strictly a fish? Never mind.

mid: I wrote down that you came by. Day eleven. Third time.

I named a ripple after you. Unofficially.

max: The chart is finished. You are in the legend. In the very first line.

low: Oh! You are the one from the museum! Hi!
